headline: Haleon Pakistan has started manufacturing Panadol 500mg tablets at its Jamshoro facility in Sindh, the company told the Pakistan Stock Exchange on Friday.

card.desc: Tablets get a beacon engraving; quality and efficacy unchanged.

caption:
Haleon Pakistan has started manufacturing Panadol 500mg tablets at its Jamshoro facility in Sindh, the company told the Pakistan Stock Exchange on Friday, Business Recorder reports. The locally made tablets carry a beacon engraving instead of the 'Panadol' text, and the company says quality and efficacy are unchanged.
